subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 04, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - September 4, 2026**

**Top Development:**

Audacity 4.0 Released!

The Audacity audio editor has been updated to version 4.0, bringing with it notable changes and improvements. This release is now available for download and can be installed on AcreetionOS via our package manager. We're excited to see the impact this update will have on our community of audio enthusiasts!

**Community News:**

Our community has been buzzing with activity, and we're thrilled to see so many contributors working together to make AcreetionOS the best it can be. A big thank you to everyone who has contributed to our project so far!

**Practical Tip:**

Did you know that you can use the `sudo` command to update your system packages to the latest version? Simply run `sudo pacman -Syu` in your terminal to update your packages and keep your system up-to-date. This is a quick and easy way to ensure you have the latest security patches and features.

That's all for this week's newsletter. As always, we're grateful for your support and look forward to seeing what the future holds for AcreetionOS!
